g: (Hong Kong, Singapore, Malaysia, chiefly text messaging or Internet slang) Pseudo-acronym of remember.
A Usenet control message indicating that a newsgroup should be removed.
Every Usenet groups, and all its associated problems, will have been wiped off the face of the Earth forever by the might of the rmgroup.
(transitive) To remove (a newsgroup) or attempt to do so by means of such a message.
Of course, to prevent any power-crazed maniacs from putting the groups back, the newsgroup `control' will be rmgrouped.
(Internet slang, historical, from 1995 to 2024) A participant in the Usenet newsgroup rec.music.hip-hop.
